name: Mahadev & Sons
description: Mahadev is a man of principles, leading a strict household as the family head! But bound to fly high, his children rebel, and a generational clash ensues!

videos.title: The Journey of Mahadev, Vidya
videos.overview: Once inseparable sisters, Bhanu and Vidya are torn apart when Vidya marries Mahadev. Will Vidya and Mahadev stay united and overcome the challenges ahead?

videos.title: Bhanu Draws the Battle Line
videos.overview: Twenty-five years later, Bhanu performs a pooja, praying for Mahadev's downfall. Later, she openly challenges Mahadev to see whose celebration draws a bigger crowd.

videos.title: Dheeraj's Grand Announcement
videos.overview: Dheeraj openly mocks the challenge and announces a lavish anniversary celebration. Later Mahadev and Bhanu's families unexpectedly come face to face at the same temple.

videos.title: Mahadev's Empty Celebration
videos.overview: Mahadev and Bhanu's families pray together before exchanging taunts about future separations. Later, Mahadev emotionally reveals he's an orphan as no guests attend his anniversary.

videos.title: Mahadev Fears Family Divide
videos.overview: Mahadev lashes out at Bhanu for serving meat and alcohol at her home. Later, Mahadev shares his fear with Vidya about a daughter-in-law breaking the family apart.

videos.title: Dheeraj Blamed For Ketan's Crime
videos.overview: Ketan secretly steals money from Mahadev to buy a gift for Narmada. Later, Mahadev wrongly accuses Dheeraj of theft, leaving him devastated as he chooses to hide Ketan's truth.

videos.title: Bhanu Confronts Mahadev's Family
videos.overview: Mahadev explains to Vidya why he is strict with his sons to make them strong. Later, Bhanu enters Mahadev's house aggressively with her family and Rajji, reopening old tensions.

videos.title: Rajji's Misunderstood Truth
videos.overview: Mahadev beats Dheeraj after Rajji reveals the truth of the letter, Dheeraj vows to marry per his wishes. Later, Bhanu confronts Rajji while Radha predicts romance ahead.

videos.title: Satya Confronts Mahadev
videos.overview: Satya questions Mahadev why he didn't let their sons marry by choice despite his love marriage with Vidya. Later, Bhanu asks Rajji why she stayed calm when Ashish teased her.

videos.title: Bhanu Defends Priya
videos.overview: Dheeraj urges Ketan to tell Mahadev about his relationship with Narmada, while Radha reminisces about her childhood with Vidya. Later, Bhanu fights off the goons harassing Priya.

videos.title: Narmada Faces Alliance Trouble
videos.overview: Narmada grows anxious as her parents discuss her marriage alliance. Later, Ketan boldly proposes a clever plan to help Narmada send the prospective suitors away.

videos.title: Ashish Endures Heartbreak
videos.overview: Narmada firmly instructs Ketan to discuss their marriage with Mahadev. Meanwhile, Ashish feels heartbroken seeing Madhu married and gets drunk, while Bhanu spies on him.

videos.title: Bhanu Plots Her Revenge
videos.overview: Tension heightens at home when Mahadev and Vidya find Ashish drunk. Later, Mahadev winces in pain as he recalls Bhanu's words, while she plots to destroy his sons.

videos.title: Vidya Learns Ashish's Sacrifice
videos.overview: Rajji firmly confirms to Dheeraj that she hasn't shared Ashish's video with anyone but him. Later, Dheeraj reveals to Vidya that Ashish sacrificed his love for Mahadev's respect.

videos.title: Mahadev's Move Stuns His Sons
videos.overview: Ketan, Dheeraj and Ashish are stunned when Mahadev asks Panditji to find brides for them. Later, Dheeraj promises Narmada he will ensure her wedding with Ketan happens.

videos.title: Ashish Faces Mahadev's Wrath
videos.overview: As Mahadev slaps Ashish for returning home drunk yet again, Dheeraj spins a false story to cover it up. Elsewhere, Bhanu urges Rajji to keep a close watch on Dheeraj secretly.

videos.title: Bhanu Blocks The Alliance
videos.overview: Dheeraj tells Mr. Saini about Narmada and Ketan's love and urges him to speak to Mahadev about them. Later, Bhanu warns Mr Saini against arranging Narmada's alliance with Ketan.

videos.title: Mahadev's Firm Guidance
videos.overview: Mr. Saini insults Mahadev, claiming Ketan trapped Narmada. Later, Mahadev urges his children to follow his guidance, while Vidya asks Ketan to forget Narmada.

videos.title: Ketan's Words Break Narmada
videos.overview: At night, Mahadev helps Rajji when her scooty breaks down on the road. Meanwhile, Ketan gently asks Narmada to move on and forget him, leaving her shattered.

videos.title: Narmada, Ketan's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Ketan and Narmada plan to elope and marry. Later, as Ketan and Dheeraj attempt to flee to meet Narmada, Mahadev intervenes.

videos.title: Bhanu's Shocking Discovery
videos.overview: Bhanu arrives at the temple to find Dheeraj helping Ketan and Narmada marry. Later, Rajji calls Mahadev to the temple by asking for help with rice bags to expose the truth.

videos.title: Ketan and Narmada's Wedding
videos.overview: Narmada feels remorse for betraying her parents and marrying without their consent. Later, Ketan completes the ritual as Mahadev and Vidya are shocked to witness the marriage.

videos.title: Dheeraj Stands By Ketan
videos.overview: Dheeraj urges Ketan to stay strong and face Mahadev, reminding him of Narmada's support. Later, Bhanu's family grandly welcomes Ketan and Narmada, provoking Mahadev.

videos.title: Mahadev's Ruthless Authority
videos.overview: Mahadev forcefully throws Dheeraj out after a bitter clash and disowns him. Watching this, Bhanu foresees the inevitable downfall of Mahadev's entire family.

videos.title: Dheeraj's Night Of Despair
videos.overview: Dheeraj spends the night alone on a bench, hoping Mahadev will call him home. Meanwhile, Bhanu secretly plots to disturb Mahadev's family peace.

videos.title: Narmada Seeks Shelter
videos.overview: Narmada hopes for acceptance as Mahadev gives her refuge. Later, he protects her from Ramesh's rage, deepening the family conflict.

videos.title: Mahadev's Support For Narmada
videos.overview: Mahadev stands up for Narmada when Kamakshi tries to humiliate her. Later, Vidya is lost in thoughts about Dheeraj as the family gathers for the morning Aarti.

videos.title: Narmada Turns to Rajji For Help
videos.overview: Narmada seeks Rajji's help in finding Dheeraj and bringing him back home. Later, Bhanu watches Narmada's efforts for the family and vows to tear them apart.

videos.title: Mahadev's Ultimatum to Vidya
videos.overview: Bhanu provokes Mahadev's anger by claiming that Vidya is betraying him. Later, Mahadev confronts Vidya and gives her an ultimatum to choose between him and Dheeraj.

videos.title: Yash, Ramesh's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Yash and Ramesh plot against Dheeraj by sending goons who attack and stab him. Tensions rise as Mahadev and the family learn of the attack and rush to the hospital.

videos.title: Mahadev Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
videos.overview: Mahadev saves Dheeraj with his blood and apologises as he recovers. Later, Dheeraj reminds him of his expulsion, while Mahadev moves to track down the attackers.

videos.title: Ketan and Vishwa's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Ketan and Vishwa fight over Narmada crossing the line, while Bhanu urges Vishwa to apologise. Later, Dheeraj tells Narmada about Mahadev's struggles after marrying Vidya.

videos.title: Narmada Assists Vidya
videos.overview: Narmada feels grateful to Vidya and Mahadev for being gracious in-laws. Later, Narmada helps Vidya in convincing Mahadev to perform the Rudra Abhishek Puja.

videos.title: Rajji Stands Against Mahadev
videos.overview: The police arrest Bhanu and Yash over Mahadev's complaint for attacking Dheeraj. Later, Bhanu provokes Rajji, who confronts Mahadev over the allegations against Bhanu.

videos.title: Mahadev, Vidya's Valentine Vibes
videos.overview: Mahadev and Vidya join the family to dance and celebrate Valentine's Day with joy and fun. Later, Vidya consoles an upset Narmada as her parents ignore her calls.

videos.title: Saini's Dark Secret
videos.overview: Mahadev and the family celebrate Maha Shivratri. Later, they are shocked as the police bring Mr. Saini, revealing that he was behind the attack on Dheeraj.

videos.title: Dheeraj's Promise to Narmada
videos.overview: Dheeraj vows to restore Narmada's rightful respect and reunite her with the family. Later, Narmada strives to win back her family's acceptance.

videos.title: Kalyan's Evil Plot Against Rajji
videos.overview: Dheeraj overhears Kalyan plotting to traffic Rajji. Later, Narmada's mother arrives at Mahadev's house seeking help for Mr. Saini, but suddenly suffers from seizures.

videos.title: Dheeraj's Brave Confession
videos.overview: Kamakshi accuses and insults Narmada's mother of robbery. Later, following Narmada's advice, Dheeraj confides in Radha about Kalyan's plot against Rajji.

videos.title: Rajji in Danger?
videos.overview: Ketan insists Narmada seek Mahadev's permission before rejoining the job. Later, at the party, Kalyan tampers with Rajji's drink and tries to abduct her, but Dheeraj follows him.

videos.title: Dheeraj Rescues Rajji
videos.overview: Dheeraj saves Rajji from Kalyan's abduction attempt. Later, Vidya calls Bhanu to assure her that Rajji is safe and will stay with her for the night.

videos.title: Rajji Faces Bhanu's Wrath
videos.overview: Dheeraj struggles to manage an intoxicated Rajji. Later, a furious Bhanu lashes out at Rajji over her bond with Kalyan and prevents her from attending college.

videos.title: Rajji Faces Alliance Trouble
videos.overview: As an alliance suitor arrives to see Rajji, Kalyan boldly confesses his love for Rajji before everyone. Meanwhile, Narmada seeks permission from Mahadev to take a job.

videos.title: Holi Happiness at Mahadev's Home
videos.overview: Mahadev and Vidya feel happy seeing Ketan play Holi after years. As the festivities begin, a lively Antakshari competition kicks off between Mahadev and Bhanu's families.

videos.title: Rajji's Accusation Causes a Rift
videos.overview: Rajji falsely accuses Dheeraj of forcefully applying colour on her, sparking a clash. Later, Bhanu feels happy when Rajji elopes with Kalyan, making her plan succeed.

videos.title: Dheeraj Walks Into a Trap
videos.overview: Bhanu alerts the police about illegal activity at a hotel as Dheeraj and Vidya search for Rajji. Later, a raid finds Dheeraj with a disoriented Rajji, sparking a misunderstanding.

videos.title: Rajji, Dheeraj Get Married
videos.overview: At Vidya's request, Dheeraj and Rajji tie the knot at a temple. Later, Dheeraj insists on keeping Vidya's role in his marriage with Rajji a secret from Mahadev.

videos.title: A Shocker for Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev and the family are left stunned to learn that Dheeraj and Rajji are married. Later, Vidya decides to tell Mahadev the truth, but Narmada reminds her of the vow to Dheeraj.

videos.title: Vidya's Inner Conflict
videos.overview: Vidya scolds Ketan and Kamakshi for eavesdropping on Dheeraj and Rajji. Later, she expresses her guilt to Dheeraj for hiding the truth and letting him take the blame.

videos.title: Mahadev Questions Vidya's Parenting
videos.overview: Mahadev fumes at Vidya for siding with Dheeraj, who repeatedly risks the family's honour. Later, Dheeraj confronts Vidya for forcing him to marry Rajji to protect Bhanu's respect.

videos.title: Bhanu Manipulates Rajji
videos.overview: Dheeraj confronts Rajji for trying to slip out of the house secretly. Bhanu then emotionally blackmails Rajji to stay at Mahadev's house and take revenge on him.

videos.title: Dheeraj Suspects Rajji's Intents
videos.overview: Dheeraj shares his suspicions with Vidya about Rajji's intentions after meeting Bhanu. Soon after, he feels nervous about his wedding night with Rajji.

videos.title: Mahadev Regrets Dheeraj's Actions
videos.overview: Rajji tells Mahadev her marriage to Dheeraj was her own wish, while Mahadev regrets Dheeraj's disobedience. Rajji recalls memories with Bhanu as Vidya selects a saree for her.

videos.title: Vidya Stands Up for Dheeraj
videos.overview: Rajji takes the money Mahadev entrusted to Vidya, sparking suspicion. As Mahadev accuses Dheeraj of stealing from the mill locker, Vidya firmly defends him.

videos.title: Vishwa's Deadly Plot
videos.overview: Narmada confronts Ketan for buying gifts with stolen money and later comforts Rajji with festival memories. Meanwhile, Vishwa secretly schemes to kill Dheeraj.

videos.title: Vidya's Belief in Rajji
videos.overview: Mahadev announces the names for puja blessings, deliberately omitting Dheeraj and Rajji. Vidya expresses faith that Rajji will bring happiness to their family.

videos.title: Dheeraj Eases Ashish's Pain
videos.overview: A game of tug of war turns emotional as Vidya and Bhanu relive their treasured memories. Elsewhere, Dheeraj consoles Ashish as he breaks down after seeing Madhu.

videos.title: Bhanu's Outburst at Mahadev
videos.overview: Mahadev and his sons win the Best Parivaar award, but before the ceremony, Bhanu humiliates Mahadev and Rajji. Vidya comforts Rajji, who is upset by Bhanu's words.

videos.title: Rajji Stands Fearless for Dheeraj
videos.overview: Rajji bravely stops Vishwa from stabbing Dheeraj, but Vishwa shoots him instead. While Vidya worries about Dheeraj, Rajji rushes a wounded Dheeraj to the hospital.

videos.title: Vidya Fumes at Vishwa
videos.overview: Ketan reveals to Vidya that Vishwa tried to kill Dheeraj and shot him. Vishwa faces Vidya's wrath, and Bhanu confides in Vidya that she was unaware of Vishwa's attack on Dheeraj.

videos.title: Vidya Seeks Dheeraj's Forgiveness
videos.overview: Mahadev's cold detachment after Dheeraj's betrayal makes him distant from the family. Vidya tearfully apologises to Dheeraj, blaming herself for his forced marriage to Rajji.

videos.title: Mahadev's Silent Care for Dheeraj
videos.overview: Rajji watches Mahadev, secretly showing deep concern for Dheeraj. Then, Mahadev angrily confronts Vishwa for attacking Dheeraj and sternly warns Yash to control Vishwa.

videos.title: Narmada's Matchmaking Plan
videos.overview: Bhanu reveals the truth about Ashish and his girlfriend to Mahadev. Narmada and Vidya try to unite Dheeraj and Rajji, but Dheeraj calls out Rajji for faking concern.

videos.title: Kalyan Breaks Rajji's Heart
videos.overview: Rajji is heartbroken after discovering Kalyan used her for money. Dheeraj comforts her as she struggles to cope with the pain of Kalyan's betrayal.

videos.title: Bhanu Sparks Family Tension
videos.overview: Vidya is stunned to see Rajji and Dheeraj together and explains the significance of the Mangalsutra. Bhanu exposes and insults Mahadev, warning Arpita's father about the relation.

videos.title: Bhanu Accuses Dheeraj of Theft
videos.overview: Mahadev holds Dheeraj and Ketan responsible for Ashish's broken alliance. Rajji informs Bhanu of Kalyan's jewellery theft, but Bhanu plots to frame Dheeraj for stealing it.

videos.title: Mahadev Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Bhanu accuses Dheeraj of stealing jewellery from her house, and he accepts his crime, hiding the truth from Mahadev. Later, Bhanu gets Mahadev arrested from his mill.

videos.title: Rajji's Plea to Bhanu
videos.overview: Mahadev accepts the accusations and feels guilty for not raising Dheeraj well. Bhanu refuses Rajji's request to withdraw the false complaint against Mahadev.

videos.title: Bhanu's Bold Ultimatum to Rajji
videos.overview: Rajji urges Bhanu to revoke the FIR against Mahadev. Bhanu stuns everyone by demanding that she will retract it only if Rajji and Dheeraj break their marriage.

videos.title: Dheeraj Faces Tough Questions
videos.overview: Mahadev feels heartbroken by the humiliation and holds Dheeraj and Rajji responsible for it. Dheeraj struggles to answer as Ketan and Ashish press him about the missing jewellery.

videos.title: Rajji Confesses Her Guilt to Vidya
videos.overview: Rajji expresses guilt and regret to Vidya, revealing that she went out to search for Kalyan. Soon, Mahadev shares with Vidya about taking Ashish to the Swayamvar.

videos.title: Dheeraj Caught in Kalyan's Scheme
videos.overview: Mogra and her mother spring into action when goons tease her. With no other option, Rajji strikes Dheeraj on the head, rendering him unconscious as part of Kalyan's plan.

videos.title: Dheeraj, Rajji Shield Mahadev
videos.overview: Mogra and Ashish's alliance is finalised. The police arrive to arrest Mahadev for failing to produce Bhanu's jewellery, but Dheeraj and Rajji arrive in time and save him.

videos.title: Rajji Wins Vidya's Heart
videos.overview: Seeing the family happy, Vidya thanks Rajji for protecting Mahadev's reputation. Soon after, Rajji joins Narmada to uncover the truth about Mogra's family.

videos.title: Lajwanti's Trap Seals Ashish's Fate
videos.overview: Lajwanti manipulates every move, pushing Mahadev to fix Ashish's wedding with Mogra. While the family celebrates, Rajji and Narmada secretly decide to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Dheeraj's Apology to Narmada
videos.overview: Mogra and her family grow fearful seeing Sikander at their house. Rajji makes Dheeraj realise his mistake, and he apologises to Narmada for hurting her feelings.

videos.title: Sikander Kidnaps Narmada
videos.overview: Narmada's search for answers takes a dark turn when she encounters Sikander at Mogra's house and is kidnapped. Yash and Kiran are exposed when Mahadev recognises them.

videos.title: Mahadev Faces Shocking Kidnap Call
videos.overview: Tensions rise in the family as Mahadev accuses Bhanu of kidnapping Narmada. Mahadev receives a call from Sikander, who blackmails him and demands ten lakhs for Narmada's release.

videos.title: Narmada's Brave Act
videos.overview: Mahadev fails to rescue Narmada as the kidnappers escape. Narmada fights the kidnappers fiercely as Dheeraj and Rajji overpower them, freeing her.

videos.title: Dheeraj Faces a Harsh Reality
videos.overview: Narmada returns home, unaware that Mogra and Sikander are plotting something dangerous. Trying to take responsibility, Dheeraj faces a crushing setback when he doesn't get a job.

videos.title: Rajji's Job Sparks Chaos
videos.overview: Lajwanti trains Mogra on how to talk with Ashish and keep him under control. Tensions rise as Bhanu storms into Mahadev's house, accusing him of making Rajji work as a waiter.

videos.title: Maddy Enters the House
videos.overview: Mahadev supports Narmada's wish to work, leaving her emotional. Meanwhile, Radha urges Bhanu to treat Maddy with warmth as a valued guest.

videos.title: Bhanu Plots to Ruin the Wedding
videos.overview: Narmada grows suspicious of Mogra as Mahadev fixes the wedding and pushes for shared expenses. Meanwhile, Bhanu tries to sabotage the alliance.

videos.title: Rajji Confronts Bhanu
videos.overview: Mahadev apologises to Ashish for breaking his promise about the alliance with Mogra. Rajji confronts Bhanu, demanding the reason for her revenge against Mahadev's family.

videos.title: Ashish's Arrest Halts the Wedding
videos.overview: Rajji is shattered by Dheeraj's cold behaviour as Mahadev tries to fix Ashish's wedding. However, the wedding gets called off when Ashish is arrested for hitting Vishwa.

videos.title: Bhanu Severs Ties With Rajji
videos.overview: Bhanu withdraws her FIR against Ashish and breaks all ties with Rajji, leaving her heartbroken. Mogra and Lajwanti visit Mahadev's home to arrange her alliance with Ashish.

videos.title: Rajji Stands Up for Dheeraj
videos.overview: Tensions rise at Ashish and Mogra's engagement as Narmada grows suspicious over a ring. Shock spreads when Dheeraj is seen in a humiliating situation, but Rajji defends him.

videos.title: Dheeraj Gets Mahadev's Approval
videos.overview: Bhanu disrupts Ashish and Mogra's engagement by assaulting Maddy and causing chaos. Later, Mahadev allows Dheeraj to attend the wedding, warning him not to break his trust.
